prompt: Ich will OpenCL auf meinem DE1-SoC (Cyclone V) mit Quartus 17.1 nutzen. Welche aoc/aocl-Versionen und BSP brauch ich, und wie laeuft der Kernel-Compile?

assertions.name: version-lock-171
assertions.text: Answer states the FPGA SDK for OpenCL must match Quartus (17.1 for 17.1).

assertions.name: bsp-separat
assertions.text: Answer explains the BSP is per-board and downloaded separately (Terasic) for the DE1-SoC.

assertions.name: aoc-aoclx-flow
assertions.text: Answer explains aoc compile (.cl to .aocx) and aocl program/install runtime.

assertions.name: lizenz-171
assertions.text: Answer notes the separate OpenCL SDK license was removed in 17.1 (free/bundled; LM_LICENSE_FILE only pre-17.1).
